description.value:
You gather the message threads of thousands of angry technology users from the infosphere, making their pain a reality for your target whenever they use technology. The target must attempt a Will saving throw.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The first time each round the target uses a tech item, it takes @Damage[2d10[mental]] damage.

Failure As success, but the target becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Frightened]{Frightened 1} and takes @Damage[4d10[mental]] damage.

Critical Failure As success, but the target becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Frightened]{Frightened 2} and takes @Damage[8d10[mental]] damage.

system.requirements: A comm unit connected to an infosphere, used as a locus.
